sources.note: Neutrik powerCON (NAC3FCA, the blue power-in connector) shares the housing of the speakON range (same 26.8 mm round body and latch), so the model uses the NL4FXX STEP bounding box 26.83 x 30.34 x 79.25 mm with a BLUE housing and three contact holes (L, N, PE at 90, 210 and 330 degrees on a 6.7 mm radius). The powerCON drawing itself was not opened: the shared box is an assumption.
